Description: FR-AUTH-1: Login screen renders all mandatory elements
Pre-conditions: Browser open; no active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to /web/index.php/auth/login; 2. Inspect the rendered page
Expected Result: Username field (input[name=username]), Password field (input[name=password]) and Login button (button[type=submit]) are rendered; footer displays the product version string "OrangeHRM OS 5.9"

Description: FR-AUTH-1: Login form posts to the correct action with a CSRF token
Pre-conditions: Browser open; no active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Read the form action, method and hidden fields
Expected Result: Form action is /web/index.php/auth/validate, method is post, and a hidden input[name=_token] is present with a non-empty value

Description: FR-AUTH-2: Valid credentials authenticate successfully
Pre-conditions: Valid Admin account exists (Admin/admin123); no active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page directly; 2. Enter username "Admin"; 3. Enter password "admin123"; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: User is authenticated and redirected to /web/index.php/dashboard/index; the logged-in user name is displayed in the header user dropdown

Description: FR-AUTH-2: Login preserves the originally requested protected URL (deep link)
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Request /web/index.php/admin/viewSystemUsers while logged out; 2. Observe redirect to the login screen; 3. Log in with valid Admin credentials
Expected Result: After authentication the user lands on the originally requested /admin/viewSystemUsers rather than the dashboard. NOTE: PRD FR-AUTH-2 states an absolute redirect to /dashboard/index - see exploration D-01; PRD amendment recommended

Description: FR-AUTH-3: Invalid password is rejected without field disclosure
Pre-conditions: Valid Admin account exists; no active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Enter username "Admin"; 3. Enter password "wrongpass123"; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: POST /auth/validate returns 302 back to /auth/login; banner .oxd-alert--error displays exactly "Invalid credentials"; user remains unauthenticated on the login screen

Description: FR-AUTH-3: Non-existent username is rejected with the identical message
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Enter username "NoSuchUser9901"; 3. Enter password "anyPassword1"; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Banner displays exactly "Invalid credentials" - byte-identical to TC-AUTH-UI-005 so that a valid username cannot be distinguished from an invalid one

Description: FR-AUTH-3 / NFR-SEC: Disabled account must not be distinguishable from invalid credentials
Pre-conditions: A disabled user account with a known correct password exists
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Enter the disabled account username; 3. Enter its CORRECT password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is refused with the generic "Invalid credentials" message. KNOWN DEVIATION: the build returns "Account disabled", disclosing both account existence and password correctness - exploration D-02; expected to FAIL and feed the bug report

Description: FR-AUTH-3: Disabled account with a wrong password (contrast case for D-02)
Pre-conditions: A disabled user account exists
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Enter the disabled account username; 3. Enter an incorrect password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Banner displays "Invalid credentials". Compare against TC-AUTH-UI-007: the two messages must be identical; any difference confirms the D-02 account-state disclosure

Description: FR-AUTH-4: Both fields empty triggers client-side required validation
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Leave both fields empty; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: "Required" is displayed under both fields via .oxd-input-field-error-message; both inputs gain class oxd-input--error; NO network request is issued to /auth/validate

Description: FR-AUTH-4: Username empty with password supplied
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Leave Username empty; 3. Enter password "admin123"; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: "Required" is displayed against the Username field only; no request is sent to /auth/validate

Description: FR-AUTH-4: Password empty with username supplied
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Enter username "Admin"; 3. Leave Password empty; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: "Required" is displayed against the Password field only; no request is sent to /auth/validate

Description: FR-AUTH-4: Whitespace-only input is treated as empty (boundary)
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Enter a single space in Username; 3. Enter a single space in Password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Input is rejected - either "Required" validation fires or the credentials are refused with "Invalid credentials"; the user is never authenticated

Description: FR-AUTH-2: Username is case-sensitive (negative)
Pre-conditions: Valid Admin account exists
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Enter username "admin" (lower case); 3. Enter password "admin123"; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Record the observed behaviour: if the username is case-sensitive, login is refused with "Invalid credentials"; result defines the documented casing rule

Description: FR-AUTH-2: Password is case-sensitive (negative)
Pre-conditions: Valid Admin account exists
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Enter username "Admin"; 3. Enter password "ADMIN123" (upper case); 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is refused with "Invalid credentials" - the password comparison is case-sensitive

Description: FR-AUTH-2: Leading and trailing whitespace around a valid username (boundary)
Pre-conditions: Valid Admin account exists
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Enter username as " Admin " with surrounding spaces; 3. Enter password "admin123"; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Behaviour is deterministic and documented - either the value is trimmed and login succeeds, or it is refused with "Invalid credentials". No server error occurs

Description: FR-AUTH-4: Very long username is handled without server error (boundary)
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Enter a 500-character username; 3. Enter password "admin123"; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: The request is refused gracefully with "Invalid credentials"; no HTTP 500, no stack trace, and no truncation error is surfaced to the user

Description: FR-AUTH-4 / NFR-SEC: Special characters in credentials are handled safely (input robustness, not exploitation)
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Enter username "' OR '1'='1"; 3. Enter password "x' OR 1=1--"; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is refused with "Invalid credentials"; the application returns no SQL error, no stack trace and no HTTP 500; the user is not authenticated

Description: NFR-SEC: Password field masks its input
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Type a value into the Password field; 3. Inspect the input type attribute and the rendered value
Expected Result: The Password input has type="password" and the typed characters are visually masked on screen

Description: FR-AUTH-5: Forgot-password entry point navigates to the reset screen
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page; 2. Click the "Forgot your password?" element (.orangehrm-login-forgot)
Expected Result: Browser navigates to /web/index.php/auth/requestPasswordResetCode; heading reads "Reset Password" and a single Username field is rendered

Description: FR-AUTH-5: Reset Password screen accepts a username and submits
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to /auth/requestPasswordResetCode; 2. Enter a valid username; 3. Click the "Reset Password" submit button
Expected Result: The form posts to /web/index.php/auth/requestResetPassword and a confirmation screen is displayed. Email delivery itself is excluded per OOS-12

Description: FR-AUTH-5: Reset Password Cancel returns to the login screen
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to /auth/requestPasswordResetCode; 2. Click the Cancel button
Expected Result: User is returned to the login screen with no reset request submitted

Description: FR-AUTH-5 / NFR-SEC: Reset request does not disclose whether a username exists
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Navigate to /auth/requestPasswordResetCode; 2. Submit a non-existent username "NoSuchUser9901"; 3. Repeat with a valid username
Expected Result: Both submissions produce an identical confirmation response; the application does not reveal which usernames exist

Description: FR-AUTH-6: Protected route is denied while logged out
Pre-conditions: No active session; cookies cleared
Steps: 1. Request /web/index.php/admin/viewSystemUsers directly; 2. Observe the response chain
Expected Result: Server responds 302 and the browser lands on /web/index.php/auth/login; no /api/v2/ data requests are issued

Description: FR-AUTH-6: A second protected route is likewise denied while logged out
Pre-conditions: No active session; cookies cleared
Steps: 1. Request /web/index.php/admin/saveSystemUser directly; 2. Observe the response chain
Expected Result: Server responds 302 to /auth/login; the Add User form is not rendered

Description: FR-AUTH-7: Logout terminates the session
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. Open the header user dropdown (.oxd-userdropdown-tab); 2. Click Logout; 3. Observe the redirect chain
Expected Result: GET /web/index.php/auth/logout returns 302 and the browser lands on /auth/login

Description: FR-AUTH-7: Browser Back after logout does not restore authenticated content
Pre-conditions: User has just logged out per TC-AUTH-UI-025
Steps: 1. After logout, press browser Back; 2. Inspect the resulting page
Expected Result: The login screen is displayed and input[name=username] is present; no authenticated page or cached user data is restored

Description: FR-AUTH-7 / NFR-SEC: Session identifier is rotated on logout
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. Record the value of the "orangehrm" cookie while authenticated; 2. Log out; 3. Record the cookie value again
Expected Result: The orangehrm cookie value after logout differs from the value held during the authenticated session, confirming the session identifier is not reused

Description: NFR-SEC: Session cookie carries the correct security attributes
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. Inspect the "orangehrm" cookie attributes; 2. Evaluate document.cookie in the page context
Expected Result: Cookie has HttpOnly=true, Secure=true, SameSite=Lax, path=/web and no Expires (session-scoped); document.cookie returns an empty string

Description: NFR-SEC: Login POST is rejected when the CSRF token is tampered with
Pre-conditions: A valid login page has been rendered to obtain a token
Steps: 1. Capture the login form POST; 2. Replay POST /web/index.php/auth/validate with _token set to "tampered-token-value" and otherwise valid credentials; 3. Observe the response
Expected Result: Response is 302 back to /auth/login and no authenticated session is established

Description: NFR-SEC: Security response headers are present on authenticated pages
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. Request /web/index.php/admin/viewSystemUsers; 2. Inspect the response headers
Expected Result: strict-transport-security, x-content-type-options=nosniff and content-security-policy are present. Record the absence of x-frame-options and referrer-policy, and the presence of 'unsafe-inline'/'unsafe-eval' in the CSP, as review findings

Description: FR-AUTH-8: Idle session expires after the configured timeout
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; configured idle timeout known
Steps: 1. Authenticate as Admin; 2. Leave the session completely idle for the configured idle period; 3. Issue any authenticated request
Expected Result: The request is redirected to the login screen. BLOCKED: FR-AUTH-8 is marked [ASSUMPTION] in the PRD and depends on open question OQ-1 (exact timeout value); out of scope per PRD section 7 until OQ-1 is resolved

Description: FR-AUTH-2: Login endpoint authenticates and issues a session cookie
Pre-conditions: No active session; a fresh _token has been obtained
Steps: 1. POST /web/index.php/auth/validate with Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded; 2. Body: _token=<valid>&username=Admin&password=admin123
Expected Result: Response is 302 with a Location header pointing at an authenticated route; a Set-Cookie for "orangehrm" is issued

Description: FR-AUTH-3: Login endpoint refuses invalid credentials
Pre-conditions: No active session; a fresh _token has been obtained
Steps: 1. POST /web/index.php/auth/validate with body _token=<valid>&username=Admin&password=wrongpass123
Expected Result: Response is 302 with Location /web/index.php/auth/login; no authenticated session is established

Description: FR-AUTH-3: Login endpoint always responds 302 regardless of outcome
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. POST /auth/validate with valid credentials and record the status; 2. POST /auth/validate with invalid credentials and record the status
Expected Result: Both responses are HTTP 302; success and failure are distinguishable only by the Location header, not by status code

Description: FR-API-8: Protected API endpoint refuses an unauthenticated request
Pre-conditions: No session cookie present
Steps: 1. GET /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users?limit=2&offset=0 with no session cookie
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 401 with Content-Type application/json and body {"error":{"status":401,"message":"Session expired"}}

Description: FR-AUTH-7 / FR-API-8: API refuses a request bearing a post-logout cookie
Pre-conditions: A session has been established and then logged out
Steps: 1. Authenticate and capture the session cookie; 2. Log out; 3. Reissue GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=1 using the now-invalidated cookie
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 401 {"error":{"status":401,"message":"Session expired"}}; the invalidated cookie grants no access

Description: FR-API-11: Authenticated web client calls succeed with the session cookie
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. From the authenticated page context, fetch /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users?limit=2 with credentials: 'include'
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 200 with the data/meta/rels envelope - confirming cookie-based API authentication

Description: FR-API-12 / FR-API-13: Obtain an OAuth bearer token via the documented token endpoint
Pre-conditions: A registered OAuth client exists
Steps: 1. POST /oauth/issueToken with client_id, client_secret and grant_type=client_credentials; 2. Inspect the response
Expected Result: An access_token with token_type Bearer and expires_in 3600 is returned. OUT OF SCOPE: the endpoint returns HTTP 404 on the Open Source build and the vendor documentation excludes Open Source - OOS-17 and exploration D-08

Description: FR-API-14: Authorization Code with PKCE flow for external API authorization
Pre-conditions: OrangeHRM Starter or Advanced edition instance
Steps: 1. Initiate the Authorization Code with PKCE flow against the instance; 2. Exchange the code for a token
Expected Result: A token is issued. OUT OF SCOPE: FR-API-14 is marked [ASSUMPTION], is an Advanced-edition feature and is unverifiable on the Open Source demo - OOS-17 and open question dependency

Description: OOS-11: Authenticate through a third-party identity provider (LDAP / SAML / social login)
Pre-conditions: An external identity provider is configured and connected
Steps: 1. Select the external provider on the login screen; 2. Complete the provider authentication flow
Expected Result: The user is authenticated through the external provider. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-11: no provider is connected on the demo instance and the behaviour cannot be verified

Description: OOS-14: Account lockout after repeated failed authentication attempts
Pre-conditions: No active session
Steps: 1. Submit 20 consecutive failed login attempts for a known username; 2. Observe whether the account is locked or throttled
Expected Result: Account lockout or rate limiting is applied. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-14: constitutes penetration testing against a shared public demo and requires explicit authorisation on a controlled environment

Description: FR-ADM-1: System Users list renders for an Admin user
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin
Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > User Management > Users (/admin/viewSystemUsers); 2. Inspect the rendered list
Expected Result: The System Users list renders; breadcrumb shows "Admin / User Management"; each row displays Employee Name, Username, User Role and Status columns

Description: FR-ADM-1: Records-found counter matches the number of rows rendered
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the System Users list
Steps: 1. Read the "(n) Records Found" counter; 2. Count the rendered .oxd-table-card rows
Expected Result: The counter value equals the number of rows rendered on the page (for a result set within one page of 50)

Description: FR-ADM-1: Filter the user list by Username
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; a known username exists
Steps: 1. Expand the filter panel; 2. Enter "Admin" in the Username filter; 3. Click Search
Expected Result: Only users whose username matches the filter are listed; the records-found counter updates to match

Description: FR-ADM-1: Filter the user list by User Role
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; users of both roles exist
Steps: 1. Expand the filter panel; 2. Open the User Role dropdown and select "Admin"; 3. Click Search
Expected Result: Only users holding the Admin role are listed; every row shows User Role = Admin

Description: FR-ADM-1: Filter the user list by Status
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; at least one disabled user exists
Steps: 1. Expand the filter panel; 2. Open the Status dropdown and select "Disabled"; 3. Click Search
Expected Result: Only disabled users are listed; every row shows Status = Disabled

Description: FR-ADM-1: Filter the user list by Employee Name using autocomplete
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; employee "Peter Mac Anderson" exists
Steps: 1. Expand the filter panel; 2. Type "Pe" into the Employee Name field; 3. Select a suggestion from the autocomplete list; 4. Click Search
Expected Result: Autocomplete suggestions appear while typing; after selection and search only users linked to that employee are listed

Description: FR-ADM-1: Employee Name autocomplete rejects a free-text value that matches no employee (negative)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the System Users list
Steps: 1. Expand the filter panel; 2. Type "ZZNoSuchEmployee" into Employee Name without selecting a suggestion; 3. Click Search
Expected Result: An "Invalid" validation message is shown against the Employee Name field and no search is performed

Description: FR-ADM-1: Reset clears all filter criteria
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; filters have been applied
Steps: 1. Apply a Username and a User Role filter; 2. Click Search; 3. Click Reset
Expected Result: All filter fields are cleared and the unfiltered user list is restored

Description: FR-ADM-1: Filter combination returning no matches shows an empty state (boundary)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the System Users list
Steps: 1. Expand the filter panel; 2. Enter a username that cannot exist, e.g. "ZZZnoMatch9901"; 3. Click Search
Expected Result: "(0) Records Found" is displayed along with a No Records Found empty state; no rows are rendered and no error occurs

Description: FR-ADM-1: Add User form renders all required fields
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin
Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > User Management > Users; 2. Click Add
Expected Result: The Add User form renders User Role, Employee Name, Status, Username, Password and Confirm Password fields plus Cancel and Save buttons

Description: FR-ADM-1: Create a new system user successfully (positive, end to end)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; employee "Peter Mac Anderson" exists; username "qaauto0001" is unused
Steps: 1. Open the Add User form; 2. Select User Role ESS; 3. Select Employee Name "Peter Mac Anderson"; 4. Select Status Enabled; 5. Enter Username "qaauto0001"; 6. Enter Password "qaProbe1"; 7. Enter the same Confirm Password; 8. Click Save
Expected Result: A success toast is shown, the user is redirected to the System Users list and the new user appears with role ESS and status Enabled. Test must delete the created user during teardown

Description: FR-ADM-1: Submitting an empty Add User form surfaces required-field validation
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the Add User form
Steps: 1. Leave every field empty; 2. Click Save
Expected Result: "Required" is displayed against User Role, Employee Name, Status, Username and Password; the user is not created

Description: FR-ADM-1 / NFR-UX: Confirm Password shows the correct message on an empty form
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the Add User form
Steps: 1. Leave every field empty; 2. Click Save; 3. Read the message under Confirm Password
Expected Result: Confirm Password displays "Required", consistent with its five sibling fields. KNOWN DEVIATION: the build displays "Passwords do not match" although nothing has been typed - exploration D-03; expected to FAIL

Description: FR-ADM-2: Username shorter than the minimum is rejected (boundary, below)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the Add User form
Steps: 1. Enter "abcd" (4 characters) in Username; 2. Blur the field and wait for validation to settle
Expected Result: "Should be at least 5 characters" is displayed against the Username field

Description: FR-ADM-2: Username at exactly the minimum length is accepted (boundary, at)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the Add User form; username "abcde" is unused
Steps: 1. Enter "abcde" (5 characters) in Username; 2. Blur the field and wait for validation to settle
Expected Result: No length validation message is displayed against the Username field

Description: FR-ADM-2: Duplicate username is rejected
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; username "Admin" already exists
Steps: 1. Open the Add User form; 2. Enter "Admin" in the Username field; 3. Blur the field and wait for the async check to complete
Expected Result: "Already exists" is displayed against the Username field and the user cannot be saved

Description: FR-ADM-2: Password below the minimum length is rejected (boundary, below)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the Add User form
Steps: 1. Enter "abcde1" (6 characters) in the Password field; 2. Blur and wait for validation to settle
Expected Result: "Should have at least 7 characters" is displayed against the Password field

Description: FR-ADM-2: Password at exactly the minimum length is accepted (boundary, at)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the Add User form
Steps: 1. Enter "abcdef1" (7 characters, contains a digit and a lower-case letter) in the Password field; 2. Blur and wait for validation to settle
Expected Result: No validation message is displayed against the Password field

Description: FR-ADM-2: Password without a digit is rejected
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the Add User form
Steps: 1. Enter "abcdefgh" in the Password field; 2. Blur and wait for validation to settle
Expected Result: "Your password must contain minimum 1 number" is displayed against the Password field

Description: FR-ADM-2: Password without a lower-case letter is rejected
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the Add User form
Steps: 1. Enter "ABCDEFG1" in the Password field; 2. Blur and wait for validation to settle
Expected Result: "Your password must contain minimum 1 lower-case letter" is displayed against the Password field

Description: FR-ADM-2: All-numeric password is rejected (boundary)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the Add User form
Steps: 1. Enter "1234567" in the Password field; 2. Blur and wait for validation to settle
Expected Result: "Your password must contain minimum 1 lower-case letter" is displayed against the Password field

Description: FR-ADM-1: Mismatched Confirm Password is rejected
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the Add User form
Steps: 1. Enter "qaProbe1" in Password; 2. Enter "qaProbe2" in Confirm Password; 3. Blur and wait for validation to settle
Expected Result: "Passwords do not match" is displayed against the Confirm Password field and the user cannot be saved

Description: FR-ADM-1: Cancel on the Add User form discards the entry
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the Add User form
Steps: 1. Populate every field with valid data; 2. Click Cancel
Expected Result: The user is returned to the System Users list and no new user record is created

Description: FR-ADM-1: Edit an existing user's role
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; a test user created by the fixture exists
Steps: 1. Locate the fixture user in the list; 2. Click its Edit action; 3. Change User Role from ESS to Admin; 4. Click Save
Expected Result: A success toast is shown and the list reflects the updated role for that user

Description: FR-ADM-1: Edit User form hides password fields until Change Password is enabled
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; a test user exists
Steps: 1. Open the Edit User form for the fixture user; 2. Observe the form; 3. Toggle "Change Password ?" on
Expected Result: Heading reads "Edit User"; Password and Confirm Password are hidden initially and become visible only after the toggle is enabled

Description: FR-ADM-2: Password policy is enforced when changing an existing user's password
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; a test user exists
Steps: 1. Open the Edit User form; 2. Enable "Change Password ?"; 3. Enter "abc" as the new password; 4. Blur and wait for validation to settle
Expected Result: "Should have at least 7 characters" is displayed; the weak password cannot be saved

Description: FR-ADM-3: Disable a user account through the UI
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; an enabled test user exists
Steps: 1. Open the Edit User form for the fixture user; 2. Change Status from Enabled to Disabled; 3. Click Save
Expected Result: A success toast is shown; the user row in the list displays Status = Disabled; the underlying PUT carries status=false

Description: FR-ADM-3: A disabled user cannot authenticate (end to end)
Pre-conditions: A test user has been disabled per TC-ADM-UI-027 and its password is known
Steps: 1. Open a clean browser context with no existing session; 2. Navigate to the login page; 3. Enter the disabled user's username and correct password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Authentication is refused and the user remains on the login screen; no session is established. Note: the specific message text is assessed separately by TC-AUTH-UI-007 (D-02)

Description: FR-ADM-3: Re-enabling a disabled user restores the ability to authenticate
Pre-conditions: A disabled test user with a known password exists
Steps: 1. Edit the user and set Status to Enabled; 2. Save; 3. In a clean browser context, log in with that user's credentials
Expected Result: The user authenticates successfully and reaches the authenticated area

Description: FR-ADM-1: Delete a system user with confirmation
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; a disposable test user exists
Steps: 1. Locate the fixture user; 2. Click its Delete action; 3. Confirm in the "Yes, Delete" dialog
Expected Result: A success toast is shown; the user is removed from the list and the records-found counter decreases by one

Description: FR-ADM-1: Cancelling the delete confirmation preserves the user
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; a test user exists
Steps: 1. Click the Delete action for the fixture user; 2. Click Cancel "No, Cancel" in the confirmation dialog
Expected Result: The dialog closes, the user remains in the list and the records-found counter is unchanged

Description: FR-ADM-1: User list pagination beyond the default page size (boundary)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; more than 50 user records exist
Steps: 1. Navigate to the System Users list; 2. Observe the pagination control; 3. Navigate to page 2
Expected Result: Page 1 renders at most 50 rows; the pagination control is present and page 2 renders the subsequent records without duplication

Description: NFR-UX: Row action buttons expose an accessible name
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; on the System Users list
Steps: 1. Inspect the Edit and Delete buttons inside .oxd-table-cell-actions; 2. Check for accessible names via aria-label or text content
Expected Result: Each action button exposes a distinct accessible name. KNOWN ISSUE: the buttons are icon-only with no accessible name, so they are unreachable by name for assistive technology and for automation - exploration section 2.1

Description: NFR-UX: Admin module navigation exposes the documented submenus
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Admin module; 2. Inspect the topbar navigation
Expected Result: The topbar exposes User Management, Job, Organization and More - matching the FR-ADM navigation described in PRD section 3.3

Description: Self-Destruction Prevention: Admin cannot delete their own active account
Pre-conditions: Active Admin session
Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin -> User Management; 2. Select the currently logged-in Admin account; 3. Attempt to delete or disable the account
Expected Result: System blocks the action with a clear error message (e.g., "Cannot delete active/own account")

Description: Orphaned Accounts Integration: Deleting an employee in PIM disables or deletes the linked Admin account
Pre-conditions: Employee exists in PIM and has a linked active System User account
Steps: 1. Delete the employee from the PIM module; 2. Navigate to Admin -> User Management and check the linked System User
Expected Result: The linked System User is automatically deleted or disabled to prevent orphaned access

Description: FR-API-1 / FR-API-3: List users returns the standard response envelope
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. GET /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users?limit=50&offset=0&sortField=u.userName&sortOrder=ASC
Expected Result: HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys data, meta and rels; data is an array of user objects

Description: FR-API-3: User object conforms to the documented schema
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=1; 2. Inspect the first element of data
Expected Result: Each user object contains id, userName, deleted, status, an employee object (empNumber, employeeId, firstName, middleName, lastName, terminationId) and a userRole object (id, name, displayName)

Description: FR-API-4: meta.total reports the unfiltered total independent of page size
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; at least 3 users exist
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=2&offset=0; 2. Compare the length of data against meta.total
Expected Result: data contains exactly 2 records while meta.total reports the full unfiltered user count

Description: FR-API-5: limit and offset paginate correctly without overlap
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; at least 4 users exist
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=2&offset=0 and record the ids; 2. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=2&offset=2 and record the ids
Expected Result: Both calls return HTTP 200 with 2 records each; the two id sets are disjoint - no record is repeated across pages

Description: FR-API-5: sortField and sortOrder order the result set
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=50&sortField=u.userName&sortOrder=ASC; 2. GET the same with sortOrder=DESC
Expected Result: Both return HTTP 200; the ASC result is ordered by userName ascending and the DESC result is its reverse. Note the "u." table-alias prefix required by this resource

Description: FR-API-5 / FR-API-7: Invalid sortField is rejected naming the offending key
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=50&offset=0&sortField=bogusField&sortOrder=ASC
Expected Result: HTTP 422 with body {"error":{"status":"422","message":"Invalid Parameter","data":{"invalidParamKeys":["sortField"]}}}

Description: FR-ADM-1: Filter the user list by username query parameter
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; user "Admin" exists
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=50&offset=0&username=Admin
Expected Result: HTTP 200; data contains only users matching the username filter and meta.total reflects the filtered count

Description: FR-ADM-1: Filter the user list by userRoleId
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=50&offset=0&userRoleId=1
Expected Result: HTTP 200; every returned record has userRole.id = 1 and userRole.name = "Admin"

Description: FR-ADM-3: Filter the user list by status
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; at least one disabled user exists
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=50&offset=0&status=false
Expected Result: HTTP 200; every returned record has status = false; when no disabled users exist the response is {"data":[],"meta":{"total":0}}

Description: FR-API-5: offset beyond the total returns an empty page (boundary)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=50&offset=99999
Expected Result: HTTP 200 with data as an empty array; meta.total still reports the true unfiltered total; no error is raised

Description: FR-API-5 / FR-API-7: Invalid limit value is rejected or safely defaulted (boundary)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=-1&offset=0; 2. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=0&offset=0
Expected Result: Each call either returns HTTP 422 naming "limit" in invalidParamKeys or returns HTTP 200 with a safe default page size; no HTTP 500 occurs

Description: FR-API-1: Retrieve a single user by id
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; user id 1 exists
Steps: 1. GET /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users/1
Expected Result: HTTP 200; data is a single user object (not an array); note that meta is returned as an empty array [] rather than an object on this endpoint

Description: FR-API-6: Retrieving a non-existent user id returns a structured error
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. GET /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users/999999
Expected Result: HTTP 404 with body {"error":{"status":"404","message":"Record Not Found"}}. NOTE: PRD FR-API-6 documents 422 "Invalid Parameter" for the PIM equivalent - error semantics differ per resource, exploration D-05

Description: FR-API-6: error.status data type is consistent across error responses
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. Capture the 404 body from TC-ADM-API-013; 2. Capture the 422 body from TC-ADM-API-006; 3. Capture the 401 body from TC-AUTH-API-004; 4. Compare the type of error.status
Expected Result: error.status uses a single consistent JSON type across all error responses. KNOWN DEVIATION: it is a string in 404/422 bodies but an integer in 401 bodies - exploration D-05; expected to FAIL

Description: FR-API-10 / FR-ADM-1: Create a user via POST (positive)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; username "qaapi0001" is unused; employee empNumber 3 exists
Steps: 1. POST /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users with Content-Type application/json; 2. Body {"username":"qaapi0001","password":"qaProbe1","status":true,"userRoleId":2,"empNumber":3}
Expected Result: The user is created and the response returns the persisted record with a generated id, userName qaapi0001, status true and userRole ESS. Test must delete the created user during teardown

Description: FR-API-10: Create returns the conventional HTTP 201 status for a new resource
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; username is unused
Steps: 1. POST /api/v2/admin/users with a valid creation payload; 2. Record the HTTP status code
Expected Result: HTTP 201 Created is returned. KNOWN DEVIATION: the build returns HTTP 200 although a resource is created - exploration D-04; expected to FAIL

Description: FR-ADM-2: API rejects a duplicate username (server-side uniqueness)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; username "qaapi0001" already exists
Steps: 1. POST /api/v2/admin/users with the same username as the existing record
Expected Result: HTTP 422 with {"error":{"status":"422","message":"Invalid Parameter","data":{"invalidParamKeys":["username"]}}} - confirming uniqueness cannot be bypassed by calling the API directly

Description: FR-ADM-2: API enforces the password policy independently of the UI
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. POST /api/v2/admin/users with body {"username":"qaapi0002","password":"abc","status":true,"userRoleId":2,"empNumber":3}
Expected Result: HTTP 422 with invalidParamKeys containing "password" - the policy is enforced server-side and cannot be bypassed by skipping the browser

Description: FR-API-7: Create with missing mandatory fields names every offending key
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. POST /api/v2/admin/users with body {"username":"qaapi0003"} only
Expected Result: HTTP 422 with invalidParamKeys containing password, userRoleId, empNumber and status - all missing mandatory keys are reported together

Description: FR-API-7: Create with an invalid userRoleId is rejected (negative)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. POST /api/v2/admin/users with userRoleId set to 9999 and all other fields valid
Expected Result: HTTP 422 with invalidParamKeys containing "userRoleId"; no user record is created

Description: FR-API-7: Create with an invalid empNumber is rejected (negative)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. POST /api/v2/admin/users with empNumber set to 999999 and all other fields valid
Expected Result: HTTP 422 with invalidParamKeys containing "empNumber"; no user record is created

Description: FR-API-10 / FR-ADM-3: Disable a user via PUT
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; a fixture user exists with a known id
Steps: 1. PUT /api/v2/admin/users/{id} with body {"username":"qaapi0001","password":"","status":false,"userRoleId":2,"empNumber":3,"changePassword":false}
Expected Result: HTTP 200; the returned record shows status = false; a follow-up GET of the same id confirms the change persisted

Description: FR-API-10: Update rejects a payload omitting the password key
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; a fixture user exists
Steps: 1. PUT /api/v2/admin/users/{id} with changePassword false and the password key entirely omitted
Expected Result: HTTP 422 with invalidParamKeys containing "password". Documents the API wart in exploration D-06: password is mandatory even when no password change is requested

Description: FR-API-10: Update rejects a null password where an empty string is accepted
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; a fixture user exists
Steps: 1. PUT /api/v2/admin/users/{id} with "password":null and changePassword false; 2. Repeat the same request with "password":""
Expected Result: The null payload returns HTTP 422 naming "password"; the empty-string payload returns HTTP 200 - confirming only "" is accepted, per exploration D-06

Description: FR-API-10 / FR-ADM-1: Update a user's role via PUT
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; a fixture user with role ESS exists
Steps: 1. PUT /api/v2/admin/users/{id} with userRoleId changed from 2 to 1 and all other fields valid
Expected Result: HTTP 200; the returned userRole is {"id":1,"name":"Admin"}; a follow-up GET confirms the change persisted

Description: FR-API-7: Update of a non-existent user id is rejected
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. PUT /api/v2/admin/users/999999 with an otherwise valid payload
Expected Result: An error status (404 Record Not Found or 422 Invalid Parameter) is returned; no record is created or modified; no HTTP 500 occurs

Description: FR-API-10 / FR-ADM-1: Delete a user via the collection endpoint
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; a disposable fixture user exists with a known id
Steps: 1. DELETE /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/users with Content-Type application/json and body {"ids":[<id>]}
Expected Result: HTTP 200 with body {"data":["<id>"],"meta":[],"rels":[]} - note the id is echoed back as a string, not an integer

Description: FR-ADM-1: A deleted user is no longer retrievable
Pre-conditions: A user has been deleted per TC-ADM-API-027
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/users/{deletedId}; 2. GET /api/v2/admin/users?limit=50 and search for the deleted username
Expected Result: The single-record GET returns HTTP 404 "Record Not Found" and the deleted username is absent from the list response

Description: FR-API-7: Delete of a non-existent id is handled gracefully (negative)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin
Steps: 1. DELETE /api/v2/admin/users with body {"ids":[999999]}
Expected Result: An error status (404 or 422) is returned with a structured error envelope; no HTTP 500 and no unrelated record is removed

Description: FR-API-10: Delete accepts multiple ids in a single request (boundary)
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; two disposable fixture users exist
Steps: 1. DELETE /api/v2/admin/users with body {"ids":[<id1>,<id2>]}
Expected Result: HTTP 200; both ids are echoed in the data array and both records are confirmed removed by a follow-up list call

Description: FR-ADM-2: Username validation endpoint reports an existing username as invalid
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; username "Admin" exists
Steps: 1. GET /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/validation/user-name?userName=Admin
Expected Result: HTTP 200 with body {"data":{"valid":false},"meta":[],"rels":[]} - the verdict is carried in data.valid, not in the status code

Description: FR-ADM-2: Username validation endpoint reports an unused username as valid
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; username "qaprobe9901" is unused
Steps: 1. GET /web/index.php/api/v2/admin/validation/user-name?userName=qaprobe9901
Expected Result: HTTP 200 with body {"data":{"valid":true},"meta":[],"rels":[]}

Description: FR-API-8: Username validation endpoint refuses unauthenticated callers
Pre-conditions: No session cookie present
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/validation/user-name?userName=Admin with no session cookie
Expected Result: HTTP 401 "Session expired" - the endpoint must not allow unauthenticated username enumeration

Description: FR-API-8: Every Admin user-management endpoint refuses unauthenticated access
Pre-conditions: No session cookie present
Steps: 1. Without a session cookie call: GET /api/v2/admin/users, GET /api/v2/admin/users/1, POST /api/v2/admin/users, PUT /api/v2/admin/users/1 and DELETE /api/v2/admin/users
Expected Result: Every call returns HTTP 401 "Session expired"; no data is returned and no record is created, modified or deleted

Description: FR-ADM-1: Employee autocomplete endpoint backs the Employee Name field
Pre-conditions: Authenticated session as Admin; employee "Peter Mac Anderson" exists
Steps: 1. GET /web/index.php/api/v2/pim/employees?nameOrId=Pe&includeEmployees=onlyCurrent
Expected Result: HTTP 200 with a data array of matching employees, each carrying empNumber, firstName, middleName, lastName and employeeId; meta.total reports the match count

Description: FR-API-9 / NFR-SEC: An ESS-scoped session cannot read the Admin user list
Pre-conditions: An ESS user with known credentials exists and is authenticated
Steps: 1. Authenticate as the ESS user; 2. GET /api/v2/admin/users with the ESS session cookie
Expected Result: Access is refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden. BLOCKED: FR-API-9 is marked [ASSUMPTION] and depends on open question OQ-8; out of scope per PRD section 7 until OQ-8 is resolved and an ESS fixture account is provisioned

Description: Role matrix: An ESS user is denied access to the Admin module UI
Pre-conditions: An ESS user with known credentials exists
Steps: 1. Authenticate as the ESS user; 2. Attempt to navigate to /web/index.php/admin/viewSystemUsers
Expected Result: Access is denied and the Admin module is absent from the ESS navigation. BLOCKED: no ESS credentials are published on the demo; depends on the same ESS fixture as TC-ADM-API-036

Description: OOS-17: Retrieve system users through the documented Professional API endpoint
Pre-conditions: An OAuth bearer token has been obtained
Steps: 1. GET /api/systemUsers with an Authorization Bearer header; 2. Inspect the response
Expected Result: A paginated list of system users is returned. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-17: this endpoint returns HTTP 404 on the Open Source build and the vendor documentation explicitly excludes Open Source - exploration D-08

Description: OOS-17: Update a system user through the documented PATCH endpoint
Pre-conditions: An OAuth bearer token has been obtained
Steps: 1. PATCH /api/systemUsers/:id with a partial update payload
Expected Result: The user record is updated. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-17: the Open Source build exposes PUT /api/v2/admin/users/{id} instead and /api/systemUsers returns HTTP 404

Description: OOS-17: Manage user regions through the Professional API
Pre-conditions: An OAuth bearer token has been obtained; a multi-region instance exists
Steps: 1. GET /api/systemUsers/:id/regions; 2. PUT /api/systemUsers/:id/regions with a region list
Expected Result: User regions are returned and updated. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-17: user regions are an Advanced-edition concept with no equivalent in the Open Source build

Description: FR-ADM-17: Register an OAuth client screen loads under Admin Configuration
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin
Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Register OAuth Client; 2. Observe the screen
Expected Result: The Register OAuth Client screen renders its form fields. The screen itself is a listed FR-ADM-17 requirement and is in scope; obtaining a working token from it is covered by TC-AUTH-API-007 and is out of scope

Description: Role Downgrade Mid-Session: Downgraded user loses access immediately on next API call
Pre-conditions: Admin A and Admin B exist. Admin B is actively logged in.
Steps: 1. Admin A changes Admin B role to ESS; 2. Admin B attempts to fetch the users list via API (GET /api/v2/admin/users)
Expected Result: Admin B receives a 403 Forbidden error; role changes take effect mid-session without requiring re-login

Description: Whitespace Padding: Trailing and leading spaces in usernames are trimmed
Pre-conditions: Active Admin session
Steps: 1. Create a user with username " spacedUser "; 2. Attempt to login with "spacedUser" (no spaces)
Expected Result: API trims whitespace upon creation; login succeeds with the trimmed version

Description: Brute Force/Rate Limiting: System locks account or requires CAPTCHA after multiple failed login attempts
Pre-conditions: Valid Admin account exists; no active session
Steps: 1. Attempt to login with an incorrect password 20 consecutive times for the same username; 2. Observe system response on the 21st attempt
Expected Result: System temporarily locks the account or presents a CAPTCHA to prevent brute force attacks

Description: Concurrent Sessions: System handles simultaneous logins for the same user correctly
Pre-conditions: Valid Admin account exists
Steps: 1. Login with Admin account on Browser A; 2. Login with the same Admin account on Browser B; 3. Perform an action on Browser A
Expected Result: System handles concurrent sessions gracefully (either invalidates the oldest session, or permits both without data corruption)

Description: Session Privilege Expiration: API requests reject gracefully after idle timeout
Pre-conditions: Active authenticated session
Steps: 1. Leave session idle until the timeout period expires; 2. Attempt a state-changing API request from the UI (e.g., Save User)
Expected Result: API returns 401 Unauthorized; UI gracefully handles the error and redirects to the login screen without freezing

Description: IDOR / Privilege Escalation: ESS token cannot access Admin API endpoints
Pre-conditions: ESS User account exists with valid API token/cookie
Steps: 1. Authenticate as ESS user to obtain token/cookie; 2. Send GET /api/v2/admin/users with the ESS token
Expected Result: API returns 403 Forbidden; ESS user cannot enumerate admin resources

Description: Input Sanitization (XSS): API escapes HTML/JS payloads in Username field
Pre-conditions: Active Admin session
Steps: 1. Create a user via API with username `<script>alert('XSS')</script>`; 2. Navigate to the UI User List to view the entry
Expected Result: API safely stores the payload and UI escapes it during rendering; the script does not execute

Description: OOS-1: Payroll processing for a system user
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin; an employee with salary components exists
Steps: 1. Attempt to generate a payslip and compute statutory deductions for the employee
Expected Result: Payroll is calculated and a payslip is produced. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-1: no payroll engine exists in OrangeHRM Open Source; PIM stores salary components as reference data only

Description: OOS-6: Authenticate through the native mobile application
Pre-conditions: A native iOS or Android build is installed
Steps: 1. Open the native mobile app; 2. Enter valid credentials and sign in
Expected Result: The user authenticates in the native app. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-6: only the responsive web UI is in scope

Description: OOS-8: Isolate system users across multiple companies in one instance
Pre-conditions: A multi-company instance is configured
Steps: 1. Create a user under company A; 2. Authenticate as a company B administrator and attempt to view that user
Expected Result: Users are isolated per company. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-8: a single organisation per instance is supported

Description: OOS-12: Password reset email is delivered and contains a working reset link
Pre-conditions: A deliverable mail route and mailbox access are available
Steps: 1. Submit a password reset request for a known username; 2. Open the resulting email; 3. Follow the reset link and set a new password
Expected Result: The reset email is delivered and the link completes the reset. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-12: the demo instance has no deliverable mail route so notification content cannot be asserted end to end

Description: OOS-13: Sustained concurrent login load against the demo instance
Pre-conditions: A load generation harness is available
Steps: 1. Drive 500 concurrent authentication requests against /auth/validate for 10 minutes; 2. Record response times and error rates
Expected Result: Response times remain within the NFR-PERF targets. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-13: generating load against a shared public demo is not authorised; applies to a dedicated test environment only

Description: OOS-16: The Upgrade call-to-action navigates to the vendor marketing page
Pre-conditions: Authenticated as Admin
Steps: 1. Click the Upgrade button in the application header; 2. Observe the destination
Expected Result: The vendor upgrade page opens. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-16: the Upgrade CTA and all linked orangehrm.com marketing pages are an external marketing surface, not product functionality

Description: OOS-15: Previously created system users persist across demo resets
Pre-conditions: A user was created in an earlier test session
Steps: 1. Create a system user; 2. Wait for the demo instance to reset; 3. Search for that user in the System Users list
Expected Result: The user record is still present. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-15: the public demo resets periodically and tests must create their own data rather than depend on pre-existing records - see also exploration D-10

Description: OOS-10: System user table schema and index configuration
Pre-conditions: Direct database access is available
Steps: 1. Inspect the ohrm_user table schema, indexes and constraints; 2. Verify the uniqueness constraint on the username column
Expected Result: The schema enforces uniqueness at the database layer. OUT OF SCOPE per OOS-10: database schema and infrastructure sit below the application boundary
